messages.author: c10ea2800751e411
messages.subject: newbie access to app problem
parts:
I've just uploaded my Shiny app to shinyapps.io and the dashboard tells me the app is running at http://mac24.shinyapps.io/pop_models.  However, when I point my browser there I consistently get the error message:

The requested URL "http://mac24.shinyapps.io/pop_models/" cannot be found or is not available. Please check the spelling or try again later.


Any help would be greatly appreciated.  I apologize in advance if I'm doing something obviously dumb-- I new to Shiny and shinyapps.io.  The app runs fine when I run it locally with runApp().

Best,

Mike C.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: newbie access to app problem
parts:
That is okay. I looked at your source code, and the problem should be
fairly easy to solve. As I mentioned in the previous reply, please
read this article http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/unicode.html if
your app uses non-ASCII characters anywhere. The short answer is to
use UTF-8 as your character encoding. You seem to be using
Windows-1252 for files that contain multibyte characters, e.g. line
1121 in server.r (the curly double quotes).

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
